//exclude: The renderer is checked by tsconfig.renderer.json, which is the only config with the DOM lib. Keeping DOM out of THIS one is what stops main-process code reaching for document or window by accident.
//include: `packaging/` is type-checked here but never emitted — tsconfig.build.json narrows `include` back to src/. Those modules are loaded by RAW NODE from electron-builder's hooks, so they import only Node builtins; checking them here is what stops that constraint drifting silently.
